The '''Sermerian First House''' was the noble body that ruled [[Sermeria]] from its capital city of [[Addolis]] during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. [[Ister Paddie/Legends|Ister Paddie]] was a noble of the House before going to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to represent his people in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. As befitted a noble of the House, Paddie wore golden robes and the orthodox [[Halbara/Legends|Halbara]] hairstyle.

Circa [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the House and its [[President/Legends|president]], [[Dibra Born]], received a suspicious package and the government was forced to shut down for several hours until a bomb squad and the [[Sermerian Bio-League]] contained the threat.
